releases.notes:
**InputBooster v4.0.0 — Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric)**

Also available for Minecraft 26.2: `inputbooster-4.0.0-fabric-mc262.jar` from the [v4.0.0-mc26.2 release](https://github.com/Ahaduzzamankhan/inputbooster/releases/tag/v4.0.0-mc26.2).

**Minecraft:** 26.2 · 26.3

**Major changes:**

- **CPU optimization** — the server identity is derived at most once per engine window instead of every tick
- **Memory optimization** — the per-tick key snapshot and key-binding rebuilds now only run when something actually changed
- **Disk optimization** — settings changes are coalesced and written once on a background thread, atomically
- **Chunk optimization** — deliberately delegated to vanilla/Sodium/Lithium; the engine schedules no chunk and unloads nothing behind the player
- **Input optimization** — the poller drops to 20 Hz on menus and while paused (where every sample is discarded anyway) and keeps the full configured rate in-game; sub-tick resolution is untouched
- **Adaptive optimization engine** — module checks run on a window that stretches when nothing is pending; steady-state cost is one comparison per tick
- **Completely silent engine operation** — no chat, HUD, toast or action-bar output from the performance engine
- **New Performance Engine section** in the in-game settings GUI with every module switch, the engine check interval and the write delay
- **All existing gameplay features are kept**: CPS limiter, w-tap, auto-sprint, auto-strafe, anti-idle, burst mode, replay, click sounds, profiles, and the HUD overlay

No FPS percentage is claimed for this release: nothing was benchmarked in a running client. The engine's own metrics — rebuilds skipped, idle poll cycles, file writes per burst of changes — are counted when they happen, not estimated.

releases.notes:
InputBooster v4.0.0-alpha-2

Minecraft:
- 26.2
- 26.3

Major changes:
- CPU optimization
- Memory optimization
- GPU optimization
- Disk optimization
- Chunk optimization
- Input optimization
- Adaptive optimization engine
- The new engine is completely silent: it adds no HUD, overlay, chat, toast or notification

All previous features are kept and unchanged — CPS limiter, w-tap, auto-sprint,
auto-strafe, anti-idle, burst mode, input replay, click sounds, combo keys, the
HUD overlay, the debug read-out and the full settings screen. The optimisation
engine is purely additive.

Measured, not claimed:
- The engine's tick path allocates zero bytes per tick over 200,000 ticks
  (read from the JVM's own per-thread allocation counter; the test is
  non-vacuous and was verified to fail when an allocation was reintroduced).
- Settings writes move off the render thread onto one lazily created worker
  that coalesces a burst of changes into a single write.
- Server identity is re-derived only when it changes.

No FPS or frame-time improvement is claimed anywhere in this release: it was not
benchmarked in a running client, so there is no number to quote.

The GPU and chunk modules deliberately add nothing. Chunk scheduling and mesh
upload belong to Sodium, Lithium and vanilla's own priority queues, and a second
mod injecting into those is the usual source of crashes; the engine therefore
touches no chunk, unloads nothing behind the player and issues no draw calls of
its own.

Install: `inputbooster-4.0.0-alpha-2-fabric-mc262.jar` or
`inputbooster-4.0.0-alpha-2-fabric-mc263.jar`.

releases.notes:
## \[2.0.4] - 2026-04-05

### 🚀 Port — Minecraft 26.1.1 "Tiny Takeover"

This release ports InputBooster to **Minecraft 26.1.1**, the April 2026 "Tiny Takeover" hotfix drop (protocol 775, data version 4788). It is the first fully unobfuscated Minecraft release. No gameplay or feature changes were made — this is a pure compatibility update.

### 🔧 Changed

* **Minecraft target:** `1.21.1` → `26.1.1` (also supports `26.1` base drop)
* **Java toolchain:** `21` → `25` (required by MC 26.1.x)
* **Mappings:** Yarn → Official Mojang mappings (no Yarn for 26.1.x yet)
* **Fabric API:** Updated to `0.145.3+26.1.1`
* **fabric-loader:** Updated to `0.18.6`
* **Gradle wrapper:** `8.8` → `9.4.1` (fabric-loom 1.15-SNAPSHOT requires ≥ 9.4.1)
* **Mod version string:** `2.0.4-26.1.1` (encodes both mod version and MC target)
*  **F3 integration:** in `2.0.4-26.1.1` we removed **F3 integration** For some technical reason it will fixed in next update. 
### 🐛 Fixed

* **Build failure:** `gradle build` was failing with *"Plugin net.fabricmc:fabric-loom:1.9-SNAPSHOT requires at least Gradle 8.11. This build uses Gradle 8.8."* Resolved by upgrading `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties` to Gradle 8.11.

### 📝 Notes

* `26.1` (data version 4786) and `26.1.1` (data version 4788) are both supported. To target the base `26.1` drop, change `26.1.1` → `26.1` in `build.gradle` dependencies and fabric-api suffix accordingly.
* Yarn mappings for 26.1.x do not yet exist. When they become available, the project can optionally switch from `loom.officialMojangMappings()`.
